script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. LUCAS & CO. - DAY

A bustling, modern tech company. Employees walk around, heads buried in laptops, phones pressed to their ears. The hum of keyboards and chatter of voices fill the space.

At the front desk, REBECCA (30s, poised, kind) greets each employee with a warm smile. SARAH (20s, eager, tech-savvy) sits next to her, pecking away at her computer.

REBECCA
(to Sarah)
How's the new project coming along?

SARAH
Slow and steady. But I think I've got a breakthrough.

They share a moment of excitement.

INT. LUCAS & CO. - BREAK ROOM - LATER

Rebecca and Sarah sit at a table with JIM (40s, jovial, experienced), TINA (50s, no-nonsense, efficient), and RILEY (20s, quirky, creative). They're enjoying lunch together.

TINA
I can't believe you two haven't figured out a solution yet.

RILEY
It's not that easy, Tina.

REBECCA
(defensive)
We're making progress.

Sarah looks at Rebecca, her expression telling the others she agrees.

JIM
(laughing)
Well, we'll be here to support you.

They all laugh and continue eating.

INT. LUCAS & CO. - REBECCA'S OFFICE - LATER

Rebecca sits at her desk, looking frustrated. She types away at her computer, her eyes glued to the screen.

Suddenly, a knock at the door. It's Sarah.

SARAH
(excitedly)
I've got it!

Rebecca looks up, intrigued.

REBECCA
(skeptically)
Really?

Sarah explains her idea, and Rebecca's face lights up with excitement. They spend the next hour brainstorming and refining the concept.

INT. LUCAS & CO. - BREAK ROOM - NIGHT

The group gathers around the table for their end-of-day debrief. They share stories about their successes and challenges, and Rebecca and Sarah discuss their breakthrough.

Riley looks at them with admiration.

RILEY
You two make a great team.

Jim nods in agreement.

JIM
You'll have that project wrapped up in no time.

Tina smirks.

TINA
And we'll all be here to celebrate.

They all laugh and prepare to head home.

INT. LUCAS & CO. - DAY

The next day, Rebecca and Sarah work together at their desks, their heads down, focused on their project.

The day passes, and as the sun sets, Rebecca looks up from her computer to see Sarah still working.

REBECCA
(smiling)
You don't have to stay late, Sarah.

SARAH
(looking up)
I know, but I want to make sure we get this right.

They share a smile and continue working.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
